entries.author: Keavon
entries.current_title: Show HN: Graphite, a Blender-inspired 2D procedural design Rust app
entries.excerpt: For the past three years I've been building what I hope will be the next Blender, tackling the lack of any good 2D design or image editing tools outside the Adobe monopoly. This was our first year participating in Google Summer of Code and this Q3 update includes the big payoff from that, covering the most progress we've made so far as a project. If you're a Rust dev, consider getting involved as we apply for the next GSoC in the new year— you could be our intern next summer

entries.title: Show HN: RF Hunter – Find hidden cameras and other devices
entries.author: RamboRogers
entries.current_title: Show HN: RF Hunter – Find hidden cameras and other devices
entries.excerpt: This project is an RF Signal Scanner built using an ESP32, AD8317 RF detector, and various other components. It's designed to detect and measure RF signals in the environment and display the signal strength on an OLED display. It's useful to find hidden cameras, wiretapping devices, and other RF-enabled devices.
entries.guide_zh: RF Hunter 通过检测射频信号寻找隐藏摄像头及其他发射设备。

entries.title: Show HN: I 3D scanned the tunnels inside the Maya Pyramid Temples at Copan
entries.author: lukehollis
entries.current_title: Show HN: I 3D scanned the tunnels inside the Maya Pyramid Temples at Copan
entries.excerpt: With these 3d captures, you can explore the 4km tunnel system that archaeologists created inside the temples at Copan that are closed to the public. The tunnels are often flooded by hurricanes and damaged by other natural forces--and collapsed on me and my Matterport scanner more than once--so this is a permanent record of how they appeared in 2022-23.
